speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE). Based on the seizure onset at three days of life, lethargy, and the absence of specific metabolic markers like a sweet odor (ruling out ketotic hypoglycemia or organic acidemias), the clinical picture strongly suggests perinatal asphyxia with secondary neurological injury. The head CT review will confirm basal ganglia or watershed infarctions typical of moderate to severe HIE.
